lindverneStand.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset: transparent full-body character standing illustration for a Chinese game-character chat app.
Edit target IMAGE 1 is the accepted fan-art of Lindverne from Zenless Zone Zero. Preserve this character's face, eye colors, silver twin tails, outfit, proportions, two tall angular ornaments, smiling lively expression, blue/black/magenta palette and polished Zenless Zone Zero anime key-art cel shading. Add ONE accurately referenced greatsword she is really holding. This is a weapon addition to the existing character, not a redesign.
Reference roles: IMAGE 2 (game cutscene at 182s) is primary reference for the WHOLE sword shape and ornament placement. IMAGE 3 (game cutscene at 258s) is the blade surface close-up. IMAGE 4 (official PV at 103.3s) shows the grip and diamond star crossguard. IMAGE 5 (official PV at106.8s) shows whole weapon length. Only the silver-haired Lindverne's black/silver/pink sword in these references belongs here. Ignore all other characters, backgrounds, captions, watermarks, borders and their weapons.
Weapon geometry, faithful to refs:
- A long narrow charcoal grip with slim gold rings and a pointed dark pommel accented pink.
- Immediately below the grip, an angular black diamond/four-point-star crossguard with a pale gold/silver inset and a RED four-point star in its center.
- Below that, at the blade root, a large thick DARK charcoal four-petal/trefoil-like sculpted structure with smoothly curling bevels and vivid magenta elongated teardrop insets. This is a broad planar flower motif integrated into the blade, not a round orb, axe or shield.
- A substantial broad flat black-gray blade with slightly inward-curving edges and SILVER metal bevels along both sides; central fine engraved panel lines, a narrow magenta longitudinal groove, and a small glowing pink four-point detail near its upper half. Small pale clover details at the root shoulders as in image3.
- At the distal end, a SECOND large PALE SILVER sculpted FOUR-PETAL flower/clover terminal plate, edged in dark gray, with softly pointed curved lobes and a slim DARK CROSS groove across its center. Copy this distinctive widened silver clover-shaped end from image2. The sword does NOT terminate in a generic skinny triangular point. The blade is a single integrated wide sword, no scythe, no axe handle, no staff, no extra floating pieces.
Composition: a clean portrait full-body illustration, all head ornaments, boots and the entire sword visible with margin. Her own RIGHT hand (viewer LEFT), formerly making a gesture, now naturally closes around the sword's grip near chest height, thumb correctly opposing fingers. Bend that forearm only as needed. Sword descends mostly vertically just outside the left side of the body, tilted slightly outward, broad blade face readable, silver flower tip near lower calf/ankle level. Keep her other arm graceful and relaxed. Character may be shifted slightly right / scaled down minimally to fit weapon, but preserve her expressive torso/leg pose. Sword about two thirds to three quarters of her height, substantial but not covering her face or torso. Hands touch the actual grip, no floating prop, no extra hands.
Identity invariants: own RIGHT eye gold (viewer left), own LEFT eye blue-violet (viewer right). Exactly two charcoal angular zigzag headpieces with broad gray four-petal shield bases and pink diamond centers, NOT curled ram horns. Silver gray waist-length twin tails. Navy fitted costume, charcoal halter chest, gold-rimmed waist opening, TWO pink FOUR-petal waist flowers, short blue skirt and charcoal hip plates with pink X stars, exactly two pink/black ribbon tails with white hollow stars, left-thigh black floral garter, black mid-calf boots with champagne toes. Preserve existing design, no new cape, crown or armor redesign.
Rendering: sharp confident line art, strong clean cel-shadow shapes, controlled metallic highlights matching the source, light polished 2D/3D ZZZ promotional character illustration look. Weapon metal must have coherent volume and detail, not photoreal steel.
Background: genuine transparent RGBA, fully clear outside the character and sword; no gray backdrop, glow aura, vignette, checkerboard painting, text, logo, border, ground, sparks or other props.
